steps.step: X1.(Q1) M(z) = Robin-to-Dirichlet map of the LOCAL sparse disc Laplacian: K(-2)-K(-1) at the square marks -> geometric row, converging
X2.(uniqueness) flat disc DtN = |n|; massive bulk and a radial conductivity (sigma = 1 at the seam) give DtN != |n| -> different M(z) (Calderon: DtN fixes an isotropic conductivity)
X3.(Q2) Dirichlet energy of the harmonic extension of cos(n theta) = pi n = 2 pi |n| |f_n|^2: the H^{1/2} trace form, i.e. the canonical 1/sqrt|n| access
X4.(Q4) on harmonic functions DtN = r d_r = dilation generator (radial quantisation: L0 + Lbar0 from the bulk stress tensor); M(z) is its resolvent
X5.(statement) the reconstructing bulk is the 2D Euclidean disc (compiler geometry; its reflected double is the chi = 2 sphere of P1): no 3+1D geometry follows
steps.detail: Theorem D stays open; the disc is the state-preparing Euclidean half of the RP double
